reviews.title: 100% worth it
reviews.contents: Used it leading up to birth to meditate. It was so supportive to track surges, confirm established labour and manage surges with guided breath counts throughout my unmedicated labour and delivery.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.contents: Used for both my births and during pregnancy. Found it so helpful.

reviews.title: It wasn’t too helpful
reviews.contents: The options are limited and overall I haven’t used it or felt the need to use it in last 2 yrs. The birth was okay without the help of this app.

reviews.title: Invaluable addition to your birthing team!
reviews.contents: I am so happy to have stumbled upon Freya just days before the birth of our second baby. After a heavily intervened traumatic birth with our first baby, I had been practicing hypnobirthing to prepare for our second birth with the hopes of having a more relaxed and physiological experience. With the help of Freya our dream birth was accomplished! Absolutely zero interventions, not even a cervical check was needed, as I arrived in hospital in active labour ready to go! Baby made their way down guiding me to use breath, and yielding into the surges. Freya was a huge gift in allowing us to stay home until active labour and only needing to be hospital for active labour, and a few hours post birth! I honestly do not think my hypnobirthing work would have been as effective as it was without the wonderful guidance and gentle care of Freya! I really appreciate how intuitive and accessible the app is, especially financially! What a gift, as it can allow more birthing folks to birth with their own bodies and babies as guides! Thank you Freya!

reviews.title: Best timer ever
reviews.contents: This timer was SO helpful, I had a very quick birth without many supports and having coaching and breath support was life changing helpful

reviews.title: super intuitive and easy to use! love the meditations.
reviews.contents: the freya app made it so, so easy for me to track my contractions and confirm when i was in active labour. the app itself is extremely intuitive and easy-to-use -- no learning curve. i loved the meditations and appreciated how easy it was to turn them on and off depending on how i felt throughout labour. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.title: Best Helper
reviews.contents: Wonderful support in labor - and couldn’t imagine how helpful it will be to time surges and how important the relaxation it between will be. We used Freya from the first surge to actual pushing at our home birth.

reviews.title: I credit this app for helping me be so present during my labour
reviews.contents: From the moment I felt my first contraction, I put in my headphones and had this app playing. As my surges became stronger and stronger, the app allowed me to stay present and breath through each surge. I had essentially zero anxiety throughout my entire labour and I believe it’s because I was so focused on listening and breathing in the app. I highly recommend this app and it’s worth the price! #firsttimemom #canada

reviews.title: Everyone should use this app, it changed my life!
reviews.contents: I used the PBC digital pack and Freya app for my second pregnancy. It was absolutely life changing. We were able to have the home birth of our dreams thanks to the programs help in building our confidence through knowledge and meditation. We used the app through our entire labour and it was completely responsible for guiding me through my surges and pain. I can’t express enough how essential this program was in our positive birthing experience.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.contents: Downloaded this app as I started labour and I’m so glad I did. Honestly helped me have the birth I wanted and kept me focused. I listened to the mp3s a lot before labour so when I started using the app, it was like immediate relaxation! The midwives were so impressed with how well things progressed and how calm it was. I listened to it on Bluetooth headphones with volume turned up so I couldn’t hear anyone else around me. TREAT YOURSELF!!
